package.name: tactile_gui
package.description:
Minimal monitor GUI (Step 7): live 5x5 tactile heatmap + centroid overlay, built on PySide6. Subscribes to raw tactile voltages and tactile_msgs/TactileProcessed; does no processing of its own.
Note: PySide6 is NOT listed as a <depend> here -- like tactile_core, it is a plain pip package (see docker/requirements.txt), installed system-wide in the dev container, not resolvable via rosdep as a ROS package name.
